details.about: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform that millions of companies, from the largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use to accept payments and grow their revenue. This full stack engineer builds APIs, services and systems across Stripe's engineering teams, including large-scale billing features that help businesses collect and manage payments. Multiple positions are available.
duties: Design, build, productionize and maintain APIs, services and systems in Ruby, React, TypeScript and other languages
Predict and measure the performance and outcomes of the systems you design
Work with engineers and cross-functional partners to build new large-scale billing features
Turn user needs, feedback and product requirements into technical specifications, weighing cost and time
Write unit, functional and integration tests to prevent bugs and regressions
Improve engineering standards, tooling and processes, and join the team's on-call rotation
Debug and find the root cause of errors across multiple service components
Mentor and help onboard new hires
needs: Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Human-computer interaction or a related field, plus 2 years of software engineering experience
2 years working with Ruby, React, TypeScript, Java and Golang
2 years using SQL for data analysis
2 years of API development, emergency response and debugging production issues across services
2 years designing architecture and writing system design proposals
2 years writing user-facing documentation and technical integration guides
2 years translating business needs into software requirements and designs using industry-standard design patterns
details.benefits: Base salary $156,800 – $235,200 a year; any sales commissions or bonus targets, if applicable, are on top. Additional benefits may include equity, a company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses, a 401(k) plan, medical, dental and vision benefits and wellness stipends.
